parts.title: The Curious Mind
parts.text: Priya loved science more than anything. All her experiment ideas seemed to **revolve** around one central question: what makes crystals grow faster? Every careful test would **produce** a few more clues. Her little brother, who kept poking at her jars, was a constant **nuisance**, but she kept her experiments on a high shelf. Priya had her own **style** of presenting each Friday — calm, clear, and full of surprises.

parts.title: The Unexpected Challenge
parts.text: During the science fair, a **tremendous** crash of thunder shook the building and the power cut out across the whole school. Priya felt a **shiver** run through her as the lights died and the hall went dark. The only light left was a **feeble** glow from a single exit sign, but she was already thinking, checking what she could still do by candlelight. The judges worried that the storm outside would **force** them to cancel the fair entirely. But Priya was **tough** — she had worked too hard to give up now.

parts.title: The Breakthrough
parts.text: Using candles, Priya set up her crystal-growing experiment at the edge of the table. She had **sufficient** materials in her kit to run the full demonstration without electricity. A large **vessel** of warm salt water sat at the centre of her display, and within minutes the crystals began forming. Meera and Ravi watched in silent wonder as the salt structures grew. Through the window, Priya could see the lights of the town **harbour**, ships docked safely in the calm water, and she thought how science felt exactly like that — a safe, sheltered place where ideas could always come home.

parts.title: The Award
parts.text: The judges were amazed. Priya not only won first place but also received a special award for creativity under pressure. A tremendous cheer filled the hall when her name was called. Mr. Ravi told the class, "Science isn't just about fancy equipment. It's about curiosity, patience, and the courage to keep going when things get hard." Priya watched the crystals catch the light and smiled — and she knew that every experiment she would ever run in her life began with this moment.

secretPassage.instructions: Read the passage below. Fill in each blank with the correct vocabulary word from the word bank.
secretPassage.passage: Captain Mira stood at the wheel of her wooden _(1)_, guiding the ship carefully through choppy waters toward the sheltered _(2)_ ahead. The journey had been _(3)_ — an enormously long and difficult voyage across three different seas. The ship's cat was a constant _(4)_, tripping the sailors and chewing the ropes, though the whole crew loved it anyway. The wind came with great _(5)_, its raw power shaking the masts and rattling every rope on board. The lantern by the wheel gave only a _(6)_ glow — weak and dim — so Mira had to stay alert, checking the sails and the compass by memory. She could feel a _(7)_ creep through her the moment the icy spray hit her face — her whole body trembling with cold. The crossing had been _(8)_, demanding strength and stubbornness that most sailors would find nearly impossible. Yet her crew had _(9)_ food — enough biscuits, dried fruit, and salted fish to last two more weeks if needed. The planets _(10)_ around the sun, she thought, and sailors _(11)_ around the globe just the same — endlessly circling, always returning. Every captain had her own _(12)_ of leadership, but Mira's way was always the same: calm, steady, and kind.
